programme.title: REPLAY: 2022 Rose Bowl Ohio State vs Utah
programme.desc: Ohio State defeated Utah 48-45 in a high-scoring thriller at the 2022 Rose Bowl, sealing the win with a field goal in the final seconds. programme.title: REPLAY: 2019 Rose Bowl Ohio State vs Washington
programme.desc: Ohio State defeated Washington 28-23 in the 2019 Rose Bowl, holding off a furious Huskies' fourth-quarter comeback to seal the win. Quarterback Dwayne Haskins threw for three first-half touchdowns in Urban Meyer's final game as the Buckeyes' head coach, who retired after the victory.

programme.title: REPLAY: 2023 Rose Bowl Utah vs Penn State
programme.desc: Penn State defeated Utah 35-21 in the 2023 Rose Bowl, pulling away in the second half with two explosive touchdowns of over 80 yards. The Nittany Lions' victory was secured after Utah quarterback Cameron Rising left the game with an injury in the third quarter, stifling the Utes' offense.
